items.t: Fundamentals first: Here is how HSBC expects global markets to perform in 2027
items.sum: Investing.com -- HSBC expects a resilient global economy in 2027, but says sticky inflation, further interest rate hikes and ongoing fiscal concerns will make for a more mixed outlook across markets.
